newsitem.title: USA: PPG Industries may issue $200 mln in notes. [CORRECTED 23:12 gmt]
newsitem.headline: PPG Industries may issue $200 mln in notes. [CORRECTED 23:12 gmt]

text.p: PPG Industries Inc is expected to issue $200 million in notes via a two-tranche deal, market sources said on Tuesday.
Credit Suisse First Boston Corp is the lead manager.

The first tranche is expected to consist of $100 million (corrects from $200 million) in five-year notes. They are non-callable with price talk in the range of 28 to 30 basis points over comparable U.S. Treasuries.
The second tranche is expected to be $100 million in 15-year notes. They have a make-whole-call at 12.5 basis points over the U.S. Treasury note with price talk of 60 basis points.
Both tranches are rated A1 by Moody's Investors Service and single-A by Standard & Poor's.
